messages:
deploy-bot: CI/CD deploy finished: inference-runtime v2.14.0 -> prod at 2026-03-15T14:02:01Z :rocket:
cheng: noticing p95 jump right after deploy, looks like 200ms -> 1.2s at 14:03
mike: p99s are spiking, a lot of upstream 504/gateway timeouts. alerting on 5xx rate now :rotating_light:
cheng: logs show backend worker queue lengths increased, K/V cache hit rates dropped ~25%
tara: on it, tailing logs from gateway: ```
[14:03:12] upstream read timeout
[14:03:13] request stalled waiting for worker
[14:03:14] 502 gateway_error
```
dave: is this limited to a subset of routes or all models?
mike: mostly text-generation and chat endpoints, embeddings seem fine so far
product-support: any customer-facing errors? we have two customers pinging support for timeouts on chat flows
cheng: initial hypothesis: the new runtime change altered batching heuristics -> higher tail latency under existing traffic shapes
oncall-sre: I'm being paged, joining. priority: mitigate customer impact first.
cheng: propose immediate mitigation: route traffic for droplet group `prod-us-rt-1` to fallback runtime (v2.13.7) and scale up workers for 5m while we triage
= dave: how quickly can we flip routing?
cheng: we have traffic-policy toggle, doing a canary reroute 10% -> fallback now. running command:
```bash
redwoodctl traffic set --from prod-us-rt-1 --to prod-fallback-rt --percent 10
```
mike: executing now. will monitor p95/p99 and 5xx.
(30s later)
mike: 10% reroute done. metrics: slight reduction but still high p99.
cheng: escalate to 50% if no regression in 30s. leaving runbook note.
product-support: pushing comms to affected customers: short note: "Investigating elevated timeouts, working on mitigation."
(45s later)
mike: 50% reroute in place. p95 improved from 1.2s -> 520ms, p99 still at 1.1s but 5xx rate trending down :+1:
cheng: good. roll forward plan: if 50% stabilizes for 2m, cutover remaining 50% -> fallback. if not, immediate rollback of deploy.
oncall-sre: paging handoff: I'm oncall until 15:00 UTC, keeping watch. who will own rollback?
dave: ops can handle rollback quick. ready to execute if 100% reroute doesn't help.
(2m later)
mike: after cutting to 100% fallback routing, p95 back to 200ms, p99 240ms, 5xx back to baseline. customers reporting service restoration.
cheng: observed that the new runtime change introduced a micro-regression in KV cache prefetch; under high prefix reuse it causes head-of-line queuing. root cause plausible.
tara: since rollback restored, recommend rolling back the version in prod to v2.13.7 and reverting the change in a branch for deeper test coverage.
dave: initiating immediate rollback of inference-runtime to v2.13.7 across prod. executing:
```bash
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference-runtime --to v2.13.7 --reason "timeout regression post-deploy"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started: inference-runtime -> v2.13.7. Change request id cr-3487654321
mike: monitoring deploy progress, will update when complete
(1m later)
mike: rollback completed, health checks green. p95/p99 and 5xx rates within normal. reopening canary for QA on staging
product-support: closing customer interruptions: sent follow-up: "Issue mitigated via rollback; investigating root cause and will update."
oncall-sre: thanks team. leaving notes and assigning follow-up to eng-ml for KV prefetch test coverage and eng-runtime for targeted fix.
cheng: quick dump of relevant logs and trace ids attached to the incident ticket: INC-3487654321. trace example: `trace-0f3a9b` showing worker wait times spike during v2.14.0
dave: action items: 1) add unit/regression test around KV prefetch under high prefix reuse 2) add e2e performance test into CI simulating live traffic shapes 3) patch candidate and bench against p99 SLO
product-support: capturing impacted customers list in ticket; no SLA breach expected but we'll monitor for aftershocks.
oncall-sre: turning incident over to follow-up owners. I'll keep the incident channel pinned for 2 hours for updates. good job on quick rollback and coordinated reroute :clap:
cheng: will open PR to revert batching heuristic and a tracked fix branch referencing INC-3487654321.
(30m later)
product-support: post-incident note drafted for status page: "Brief elevated timeouts after deploy; rollback executed; no ongoing customer impact." awaiting ack from eng leads.
summary: Short deploy caused timeout regression (p95/p99 increase and 5xx); rapid traffic reroute to fallback and immediate rollback restored baseline. Follow-ups assigned for KV caching fixes and test coverage.
